subject: general
question: The SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas) Scheme, implemented by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, uses _________ for mapping of land parcels.
solution:
The correct answer is __**drones**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The SVAMITVA Scheme is a central sector scheme of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India.
 
• It aims to provide an integrated property validation solution for rural India using drone technology.
 
• The utilization of drones helps in creating accurate land maps which are essential for the issuance of property cards to rural households.
 
• This scheme helps in reducing property disputes and also facilitates monetization of rural residential assets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Drone Technology**

 
 
• Drones, also known as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), are aircraft systems without a human pilot onboard.
 
• They are controlled either by a remote control system or autonomously through software-controlled flight plans in their embedded systems.
 
• Drones are used in various applications such as aerial photography, agriculture, surveillance, and mapping.
 
• In the context of the SVAMITVA scheme, drones provide high-resolution images and accurate geospatial data which are critical for land mapping.
 
 
 
• **SVAMITVA Scheme Objectives**
 
 
• The SVAMITVA Scheme aims to map rural inhabited lands using drone technology and Continuously Operating Reference Station (CORS) networks.
 
• It aims to provide a 'Record of Rights' to village household owners in rural areas and issue property cards for land parcels in the villages.
 
• This will facilitate monetization of rural residential assets for credit and other financial services.
 
• It will also help in reducing property-related disputes and legal cases.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Panchayati Raj**
 
 
• The Ministry of Panchayati Raj is a branch of the Government of India that looks after the administration and functioning of Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).
 
• It is responsible for the implementation of schemes and programs aimed at empowering and strengthening rural local bodies.
 
• The ministry works towards the development of rural areas through various initiatives and schemes, including the SVAMITVA scheme.
